rules.title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance rent ceilings after Measure BB
rules.requirement: Landlords of fully covered units may raise rent once a year by the Annual General Adjustment, which Measure BB caps at 5%, plus banked adjustments up to the rent ceiling.
rules.coverage_conditions: Fully covered units: most multifamily built before 1980, single-family homes with tenancy before 1996, rooming houses
rules.exemptions: Partially covered units (new construction, most condos, other single-family homes, some subsidized) have no rent control

rules.title: Berkeley just cause for eviction after Measure BB
rules.requirement: Tenants in fully or partially covered units can be evicted only for just cause. Measure BB bars eviction for rent debt under one month of Fair Market Rent and for refusing a new fixed-term lease, and tightens lease-breach and notice rules.
